text:
harper: opened a small PR to tighten the 429 + timeout troubleshooting doc. Goals: replace two broken links, add a tiny repro curl that surfaces Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers, and drop a 2-line Node retry example. can someone quick-review?

noah: on it. make sure the curl uses a clearly synthetic token and a staging host. also call out Retry-After units (seconds) and that some infra returns millis in `retry-after-ms`.

harper: updated PR. curl snippet: curl -i -X POST https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <SYNTHETIC_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"mini-test","prompt":"ping","max_tokens":1}'  // shows 429 + Retry-After + X-RateLimit-Remaining

ravi: add the Node micro-snippet please. two lines with expo backoff + jitter should be enough for crosslinking from SDK.

harper: added: const backoff = i => Math.min(1000*Math.pow(2,i), 10000)+Math.random()*200; // pseudo; loop with fetch and break on success.

ci-bot: running linkcheck on branch docs/1998-trim-fallback. found 1 broken link: /guides/old-fallback -> 404

noah: that one was deprecated. suggest redirect to /runbooks/fallbacks and update anchor.

harper: pushed redirect + anchor fix. also added a short note about context limits and a `ctx-trimmer` CLI example for safe repros in staging (command references internal tool).

qa: small editorial nit: clarify "do not use prod keys" -> "do not use production API keys or customer data" and add a reminder to scrub PII before locally replaying logs.

harper: wording updated. ready for merge pending staging deploy.

dev-docs-bot: Staging docs deploy scheduled 2026-04-07 04:00 UTC. preview requested.

harper: thanks all, will close after staging preview passes :shipit:
